name: Configuration, Task Registry & Data Models
description: Parses and strictly validates apprentice.yaml at startup using Pydantic v2 models. Defines all shared data models (TaskRequest, TaskResponse, TrainingExample, ComparisonPair, ConfidenceSnapshot, BudgetState, AuditEntry, SamplingDecision, EvaluationResult variants, ModelVersion) used across the entire system. Includes the Task Registry which holds configured task types with their schemas, prompt templates, evaluator types, match fields, and confidence thresholds. Includes the config loader which reads YAML, resolves env:VAR_NAME references, and validates via Pydantic v2 strict mode. Fails fast with clear, field-path-aware error messages on invalid config. This is the foundational layer — every other component depends on these types. Structured internally as six modules: types.py (primitives/enums), models.py (shared data models), config.py (configuration models), factories.py (factory functions), registry.py (TaskRegistry), loader.py (YAML loading). Import chain: types → models → config → factories → registry → loader with no backward imports.

types.name: TaskId
types.description: Annotated[str, MinLen(1), MaxLen(128), Pattern(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$')]. Domain-specific identifier for a task type. Prevents mixup with other string IDs.

types.name: ModelId
types.description: Annotated[str, MinLen(1), MaxLen(256)]. Domain-specific identifier for a model (local or remote). Prevents mixup with other string IDs.

types.name: ConfidenceScore
types.description: Annotated[float, Ge(0.0), Le(1.0)]. A confidence score in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0]. Used throughout the system to drive phase transitions and sampling.

types.name: CostAmount
types.description: Annotated[Decimal, Ge(0)]. Non-negative decimal monetary amount for budget tracking. Decimal ensures exact arithmetic for hard budget enforcement.

types.name: AwareDatetime
types.description: datetime with required tzinfo (timezone-aware). No naive datetimes allowed anywhere in the system. Serialized as ISO 8601 string with timezone offset.

types.name: SecretStr
types.description: Pydantic SecretStr — masks value in repr/logs, accessible via .get_secret_value(). Used for API keys and other sensitive config fields.

types.name: Path
types.description: pathlib.Path representing a filesystem path.

types.name: EnvMapping
types.description: Mapping[str, str] — an immutable string-to-string mapping, typically os.environ or a test override.

types.name: JsonSchemaDict
types.description: A dict representing a JSON Schema object. Must be a valid JSON Schema with at minimum a 'type' key. Used for input_schema and output_schema on TaskConfig. Runtime type is dict[str, any].

types.name: SerializedModel
types.description: str — A JSON string produced by Pydantic's model_dump_json(). Used for serialization round-trip functions.

types.name: Phase
types.description: StrEnum representing the current operational phase. Phases are emergent from confidence scores, not manually triggered.

types.name: RoutingDecision
types.description: StrEnum representing where a request is routed.

types.name: EvaluatorType
types.description: StrEnum representing the type of evaluator used for comparing responses.

types.name: BudgetPeriodUnit
types.description: StrEnum for budget period granularity.

types.name: EvaluationResultType
types.description: StrEnum discriminator for the EvaluationResult discriminated union.

types.name: EvaluatorTypeName
types.description: Discriminated evaluator type identifiers from config. Each maps to a specific evaluator implementation.

types.name: FinetuningBackendName
types.description: Supported fine-tuning backend identifiers. Used as discriminator for backend plugin selection.

types.name: LogLevel
types.description: Standard Python logging levels for audit configuration.

fields.name: latency_ms

types.description: Root configuration model. Frozen and immutable after construction. ConfigDict(frozen=True, strict=True, extra='forbid'). Cross-field model_validator(mode='after') validates: (1) backend combinations are supported, (2) evaluator types referenced by tasks are valid, (3) match fields reference fields in task output_schema, (4) thresholds.local_only >= thresholds.local_ready, (5) budget.max_monthly_cost_usd >= budget.max_daily_cost_usd, (6) semantic_similarity evaluators have semantic_model set, (7) llm_judge evaluators have judge_prompt_template set, (8) regex_match evaluators have regex_pattern set, (9) json_schema_match evaluators have json_schema_path set, (10) all task_name values are unique.

functions.name: load_config
functions.description: Main entry point: loads and validates an Apprentice configuration from a YAML file. Pure function with no internal state. Reads the file, parses YAML via yaml.safe_load(), resolves env:VAR_NAME references using the provided env mapping (or os.environ by default), constructs and validates ApprenticeConfig via Pydantic v2 with strict mode, and returns a frozen/immutable config object. functions.name: get_model_json_schema
functions.description: Returns the JSON Schema for a model type. Useful for documentation, config validation, and client SDK generation.

inputs.name: model_type
inputs.description: Name of the model type to get the schema for.

error_cases.name: unknown_model_type
error_cases.condition: model_type does not match any defined model

preconditions: model_type is one of the model type names defined in this component
postconditions: Returned dict is a valid JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12 compatible via Pydantic)
Schema includes all field definitions, types, constraints, and descriptions

invariants: ApprenticeConfig is frozen/immutable after construction — no mutation is possible
All SecretStr fields mask their values in repr and str — secrets never appear in logs or error messages
All env:VAR_NAME references are resolved at parse time — no deferred resolution at runtime
Config validation is exhaustive — if load_config returns without error, the config is fully valid for all downstream components
No silent defaults for critical fields — api keys, model names, task definitions, budget limits, and backend selection must always be explicitly specified
Extra/unknown fields in YAML always cause validation failure (extra='forbid') — no silent field dropping
Strict type coercion — '3' as a string is not accepted where int is expected (strict=True)
All task_name values in the config are unique
Cross-field constraints are enforced atomically — either all pass or the entire config is rejected
The loader function is pure and stateless — calling it twice with the same inputs produces identical results
YAML parsing uses safe_load only — no arbitrary Python object deserialization
The TaskRegistry is immutable after construction — no tasks can be added, removed, or modified at runtime
Every RegistryTaskConfig in the registry has a unique name
len(registry) >= 1 — a registry must contain at least one task
For every RegistryTaskConfig tc in the registry: all entries in tc.match_fields are keys in tc.output_schema['properties']
For every RegistryTaskConfig tc in the registry: all {placeholder} names in tc.prompt_template are keys in tc.input_schema['properties']
For every RegistryTaskConfig tc in the registry: tc.confidence_thresholds.emergency_threshold < tc.confidence_thresholds.coaching_trigger < tc.confidence_thresholds.phase2_to_phase3_correlation
registry.task_names returns a frozenset equal to the set of keys in registry.tasks
All Pydantic ValidationErrors from invalid config propagate at construction time — the registry never exists in an invalid state
All model instances with frozen=True are immutable after construction — no field can be reassigned
All models with extra='forbid' reject any fields not explicitly defined in the schema
All models with extra='ignore' silently discard unknown fields (forward compatibility for persisted state)
All CostAmount fields use Decimal arithmetic — no floating point for monetary values
All timestamp fields are timezone-aware (AwareDatetime) — naive datetimes are rejected at validation
All models round-trip cleanly through JSON: model_validate_json(model.model_dump_json()) produces an equivalent instance
Phase is always derived from ConfidenceScore and thresholds, never set independently
BudgetState.remaining always equals BudgetState.total_budget - BudgetState.spent
BudgetState.is_exhausted always equals (BudgetState.remaining <= 0)
EvaluationResult is a discriminated union — the result_type field determines which variant is active
TaskId values match the pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$ and are between 1 and 128 characters
ModelId values are non-empty strings of at most 256 characters
ConfidenceScore values are always in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0]
No model in this component performs I/O, network calls, or mutates global state — all functions are pure (except load_config which reads files)
Composition over inheritance: no model type inherits from another model type in this component
